notes.title: DLC Retro Synthwave aka ’80s
notes.content:
The new DLC Retro Synthwave will be released tomorrow (19 May 2021).

If your goal is to create Synthwave, Synthpop, Retrowave, Vapourwave, Chillwave and other similar genres, then with this DLC, Rytmik Studio will be just the tool to let you do it.

[list]
[*] Over 250 authentic samples created and selected specially for synthwave
[*] ’80s Drums
[*] Electronic percussion
[*] Classic synthesizer bass
[*] Wide selection of melodic and accompanying synthetic instruments
[*] New "Tape" master effect–simulating magnetic tape sound to instantly give your track the appropriate retro feel
[*] 9 new unlocked demo songs
[/list]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1552100/Retro_Synthwave/

In the meantime, you can listen two of the nine demosongs.
https://youtu.be/HSAlDhFtLmo
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=eSqAX8qvcn8

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31070681/4dddcac22ffca04d953ae276fb8cd242c6fb5286.png[/img]

tags.feature: - Over 250 authentic samples created and selected specially for synthwave
- ’80s Drums
- Electronic percussion
- Classic synthesizer bass
- Wide selection of melodic and accompanying synthetic instruments
- New "Tape" master effect–simulating magnetic tape sound to instantly give your track the appropriate retro feel
- 9 new unlocked demo songs

notes.title: Update Version 1.04.x.b210228
notes.content:
[h1]Version 1.04.x.b210228 ːsteamthisː [/h1]
[list]
[*]NEW: Disabled <>:"/\|?* characters when entering export file name.
[*]FIXED: When loading a backup song, the backup will overwrite while loading samples.
[*]FIXED: User samples were not cleared when loading song from ROM.
[*]FIXED: if there's no space on the cloud, then the error message: "WRONG SONG NAME".
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31070681/827259f6d6d77270a3790969cc12d8d26fa4b2bf.png[/img]
[h1]Version 1.031.x.b200506 ːsteamthisː [/h1]
[i]On the release of the 1.03 update, we forgot to send information about what this update contains. We're fixing our mistake.[/i]
[list]
[*]NEW: Adjust the logic of a song backup in progress (when the application is closed).The new system is safer and should cause fewer problems.
[*]NEW: During visualization there is a new key shortcut (shift+space) that triggers the play preview of the selected song.
[*]NEW: If you change the quality of the graphic you no longer see the alert box about resolution.
[*]FIXED: Screen resolution change did not work in fullscreen.
[*]FIXED: Backup file is not loaded again if it was found to be corrupted.
[*]FIXED: Minor graphics errors.
[/list]
[h1]What's next for Rytmik Studio?[/h1]
[list]
[*]We plan to complete documentation and close Early Access later this year and continue support - repair bugs and add minor improvements
[*]We are also now working on a new DLC for Rytmik Studio, details will be announced soon
[*]We would also like to start featuring selected songs from active Rytmik users on YouTube
[/list]

notes.title: Version 0.71.1.b80510 – Live recording
notes.content:
Version 0.71.1.b80510 – Live recording
[list]
[*]NEW: Sound engine is reworked to achieve much lower latency. Buffer size 4096 is equivalent to previous LOW buffer setting. Buffer sizes 1024 and lower should be usable for live recording.
[*]NEW: Live recording in Clip editor. With lower audio buffers it is possible to live record notes from MIDI or PC keyboard.
[*]NEW: Metronome. It is possible to use metronome in Clip editor for live recording.
[*]NEW: Over 100 new instrument presets.
[*]FIXED: Several bug fixes.
[/list]

notes.title: Build 0.21.1.b71128
notes.content:
Two weeks have passed since the first public release. Rytmik Studio v0.21.1.b71128 is now available.

[b]Version 0.21.1.b71128 - TOOLTIPS![/b]
[list]
[*]NEW: TOOLTIPS! Enable/Disable by F1 or by "?" button
[*]NEW: Names of Suporters added to Credits
[*]NEW: Note Insert Skip setting - you can set how many beats will note cursor auto-advance after inserting the note by keyboard (both midi or PC).
[*]FIXED: New song has global reverb and delay fx volume set to 50% instead 100%. This fixes too much reverb and delay in presets and results in better reverb and delay setting.
[*]FIXED: There was a bug when saving preset with empty usersample.
[*]FIXED: In clipeditor - song mode, there were some hidden buttons still active.
[*]NEW: First Achievement for EA users
[/list]

[b]Version 0.17.1.b71117[/b]
[list]
[*]FIXED: looped export stopped when song loop was off.
[*]FIXED: export folder and name were wrong.
[/list]

[b]Version 0.16.1.b71116[/b]
[list]
[*]FIXED: Crash when importing samples with other than 44100Hz samplerate.
[*]FIXED: RANDOM for instrument made inaccessible for now - there is some more work needed to make it safe and usable.
[*]FIXED: User presets are now empty when running RS for the first time (the ROM bank was copied to USER bank, which is not desirable).
[*]FIXED: Bug in loader of Rytmik Ultimate songs - some clips were at wrong positions and behaved badly.
[*]NEW: Steam Overlay is working now.
[/list]
